hikvision.heroDesc: Next-generation security systems for complete protection of your business and home. Discover innovation at a new level.
hikvision.whoIsText: Hikvision guarantees the highest quality at affordable prices. Founded in 2001, Hikvision focuses on integrated security and scenario-based digitalization, serving diverse industries with AI-powered Internet of Things (AIoT) technologies.
hikvision.whatText1: It's time to step into the future. Whether you're considering an upgrade or a scratch install, IP is the solution. Compared to traditional analogue, IP offers better image quality, higher resolution, and advanced features like AI.
hikvision.whatText2: The strength is that all this can be done with fewer devices and cables. We offer a wide range of IP products including NVRs, PTZ dome cameras, panoramic cameras, and network transmission accessories. Based on deep learning technology, DeepinView cameras and DeepinMind NVRs are among our most advanced products.
hikvision.whyTitle: Why buy only from an authorized installer?
hikvision.whyText: To better serve customers, Hikvision has created an excellent pre- and post-sales service network for technical support, selling its products exclusively through authorized distributors and installation/integration partners globally.

dahua.heroDesc: Innovation in AIoT security. Smart solutions, top-tier video systems, and advanced management for a safer future.
dahua.whoIsText: Dahua Technology is a world-leading video-centric AIoT solution and service provider. Committed to enabling a smarter society and better living, Dahua actively implements its Dahua Think#2.0 strategy, evolving from 'Intelligence' to 'Integrated Intelligence' to drive digital innovation and transformation for cities and enterprises. The company supports urban development by enhancing management efficiency, enabling autonomous city operations, upgrading public safety systems, and advancing ecological governance. In the enterprise sector, Dahua focuses on strengthening security systems, increasing operational productivity, and enabling data-driven decision-making to help businesses thrive.
dahua.whatText1: Dahua has built a comprehensive R&D framework anchored on five core capability pillars. Based on this foundation, the company has established five specialized research institutes - Advanced Technology Institute, Big Data Institute, Central Research Institute, Cybersecurity Institute, and Product Engineering Institute. These support two major R&D directions: AIoT-based smart devices and an intelligent IoT data platform. This enables systematic development of solutions for cities, enterprises, and SMBs.
dahua.whatText2: With Hangzhou as its global R&D headquarters, Dahua has also set up regional centers in Xi'an, Chengdu, Europe, and Latin America. The company hosts a national-level postdoctoral research center and is recognized as a National Enterprise Technology Center and National Industrial Design Center. With strong innovation capabilities, Dahua continues to achieve industry-leading breakthroughs.
dahua.whyText: Working with certified partners ensures you get the latest firmware updates and full warranty.
